entries.description: Routed Session 1 ai-assignment.md authoring and wrote the result to disk.
Completed required reading for the repo workflow docs plus strategy, HHC-vs-Northwind comparison, the Add-an-Order baseline package, and the workflow-package template.
Verified there was no uncommitted prior-session work in docs/session-sets/workflow-package-pilot/, docs/session-sets/form-report-code-and-grouping/, or tests/AccessHarvester.CharacterizationTests/.
Ran the live harvester pipeline against samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb and produced raw/kb/ir output under tmp/generalization-validation-on-non-northwind/AccessMetaData/HomeHealthCare/.
Authored inventory.md capturing the Add-a-Client forms, helper modules, queries/tables, behavior-bearing procedures, Northwind analogues, and harvester coverage notes.
Authored packages/add-a-client.md in the seven-section template, including the HHC-specific OpenArgs/listbox divergences and the corrected note that tblClients has no data macro.
Added the AddAClient characterization suite covering client defaults/save gating, field validation and normalization, and delete/deactivate lifecycle policy.
Recorded harvester coverage notes inline in inventory.md, including that live extraction succeeded cleanly and that tblClients validation is form-plus-table-rule based rather than data-macro based.

dotnet build succeeded. dotnet test initially failed on a pre-existing missing tmp/comprehension-ir Northwind fixture; regenerated the canonical Northwind fixture into tmp/comprehension-ir via the harvester pipeline, then re-ran dotnet test to a fully green pass.

Cross-provider session-verification routed via query("gemini-pro", task_type="session-verification") because the router override is calibrated for Claude, not this Codex/OpenAI session. Round 1 verdict: VERIFIED. Saved raw output to session-reviews/session-001.md.
Routed Session 2 orchestrator recommendation via gemini-pro; wrote session-1-next-orchestrator-recommendation.md.

Read session-1 deliverables (inventory, package, characterization tests, session-001 review), Add-an-Order baseline package, HHC/Northwind comparison context, plus YAML/IR sources for Form_frmClientDetail, frmClientSearch, and tblClients.

Verified Session 1 of this set committed (commits 02ad8d9 and 1717f2e). Surfaced orphan uncommitted files from a prior set (form-report-code-and-grouping session-state/events) and sample binary drift. User authorized bundling the form-report state files and ignoring the .accdb timestamp drift.

Independent semantic review of packages/add-a-client.md against the YAML/IR source. Findings: four missing invariants (phone normalization via FormatPhone, state-driven city auto-fill via cboStateCode_AfterUpdate, future-enrollment-date <=Date() gating, deactivation cancel restoring active=True), plus an inferred-vs-confirmed split on FormatPhone exact mask.

Independent review of AddAClient characterization tests. Tests are anti-coupled cleanly (stub workflows, not Access mechanics) but had coverage gaps matching the missing invariants identified in the package review.

Authored Session2FalsificationTests.cs with nine falsification tests: future-enrollment gating, phone normalization determinism, three state-city auto-fill cases (exact-one, multi, none), deactivation-cancel reversibility, deactivation-confirm-with-warning, deactivation-confirm-clean, and tightened CanDelete check over multiple positive-budget counts.

Updated packages/add-a-client.md: added three new business rules (phone normalization, state-city auto-fill, deactivation-confirm-rollback), five new invariant->test entries, two new ambiguity-log questions (FormatPhone exact mask, state-city auto-fill intent), and tightened operationalization prose with the table-level EnrollmentDate <=Date() rule plus a deactivation-pattern note.

Authored generalization-findings.md with verdict generalizes-cleanly, section-by-section template-fit analysis (all seven sections clean), five pattern-divergence findings (listbox-cascade, OpenArgs, no-data-macro enforcement, mixed DAO+ADODB, Hungarian naming), three low-priority harvester-coverage extensions for a future set, and a recommended-next-move pointing at Phase 3a (Blazor update workflows) per strategy.md.
Authored change-log.md in-conversation per the in-conversation summarization convention. Verdict is the headline.

Authored next-session-set-recommendation.md: primary recommendation is Phase 3a (Blazor update workflows) per strategy.md; secondary optional recommendation is one or two more HHC packages (Add a Service Need, Copy from Prior FY) before fully committing to 3a. Plan-driven repo: no deviation from strategy.md.
Authored disposition.json before the closeout commit per the lesson from form-report-code-and-grouping Session 3 (the disposition_present closeout gate).

dotnet build clean (0 errors, 323 warnings). dotnet test --no-build green: 1848 passed, 2 skipped (Access-COM gated), 0 failed. Characterization tests: 131 passed (122 from Session 1 + 9 new Session 2 falsification tests).
Cross-provider session-verification routed via route(task_type='session-verification', complexity_hint=70). Model: gpt-5-4. Saved raw output to session-reviews/session-002.md.
Round 2 cross-provider session-verification after fixing the Round 1 Major (FormatPhone test overspecified) and two Minor findings. Model: gpt-5-4.
Round 3 cross-provider session-verification after fixing the Round 2 Minor finding (stale FormatPhone references in generalization-findings.md). Model: gpt-5-4.
Round 4 verification after fixing the Round 3 Section 7 count mismatch. Model: gpt-5-4.
